objective:
Add the domain vocabularies to core-domain as plain, public Kotlin enums in package com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain.model (one file per enum, or a small number of files; your call). core-domain is a pure Kotlin/JVM module (plugin kotlin-jvm, testImplementation(kotlin("test"))). These enums will be persisted by a later task as their constant `name` text (never ordinal), so the names are a stored contract. Exact enums and constants, in this order:
- ActivityState: COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS
- ActivityResolution: EXISTING_ACTIVITY, NEW_ACTIVITY, AMBIGUOUS, UNRESOLVED
- ProcessingState: CAPTURED, QUEUED_FOR_PHONE, TRANSCRIBED, INTERPRETING, INTERPRETED, PERSISTED, NEEDS_REVIEW, FAILED_RETRYABLE, FAILED_FINAL
- TimePrecision: EXACT, APPROXIMATE, DATE_ONLY, INFERRED_NOW
- VisibilityStatus: ACTIVE, HIDDEN
- CanonicalActivityStatus: ACTIVE, MERGED, ARCHIVED
- AliasSource: USER_CORRECTION, AI_CONFIRMED, SEEDED, MANUAL
- CorrectionSource: USER, REINTERPRETATION
- CaptureSource: PHONE_VOICE, PHONE_TEXT, WATCH_VOICE
- InterpretationOperation: LOG_ACTIVITY, QUERY_HISTORY, UNSUPPORTED
- ValidationStatus: VALID, INVALID, NEEDS_REVIEW
- ConfidenceBand: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
Each enum gets a short KDoc: what it classifies, and a one-line warning that constant names are persisted as text so renaming or removing a constant is a data migration. Keep constants bare (no constructor properties, no display strings - UI wording is not this module's job). Add a golden-name test in core-domain/src/test that pins, per enum, the exact list of constant names (entries.map { it.name }), so renaming, removing or adding a constant fails a test and forces a deliberate update. Do not assert ordinals. Delete the scaffold placeholder core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mcfrenchpants/activityledger/core/domain/ScaffoldPlaceholder.kt and its test core-domain/src/test/kotlin/com/mcfrenchpants/activityledger/core/domain/ScaffoldPlaceholderTest.kt. Note: in this pure JVM module `kotlin.test.Test` resolved previously (the placeholder test used it); if it does not, use whatever the module already supports without adding dependencies.
non_goals: Do not add data classes, entities, interfaces, repositories, validators or any other domain types beyond these twelve enums.
Do not add fields, display names, parsing helpers or companion lookup functions to the enums.
Do not change core-domain/build.gradle.kts (no new plugins or dependencies), and do not touch any other module.
Do not edit gradle/libs.versions.toml or any doc.
acceptance_criteria: The twelve enums exist, public, in package com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain.model, with exactly the listed constants in the listed order and no extra members.

A test pins every enum's constant-name list exactly; demonstrate it bites by temporarily renaming one constant, running the test, capturing the failure, and reverting (the temporary change must not be in the final diff).
ScaffoldPlaceholder.kt and ScaffoldPlaceholderTest.kt are deleted; core-domain/build.gradle.kts is unchanged; core-domain has no Android, Room or ML Kit imports.
`./gradlew :core-domain:test` passes with JUnit XML showing the new tests executed (report counts), and `./gradlew test` passes for all modules.
